answer.rationale: With expiry in 14 days and the line at 94% committed volume, continuity and delivery reliability outweigh an unvalidated primary-vendor switch. Negotiate an incumbent renewal using market benchmarks to pursue the mandated spend reduction while preserving the established integration and scheduled-delivery stability. Verify the prior negotiation outcome and incumbent continuity record before committing; do not assume an 18% reduction is achievable or accept terms that weaken delivery protections.
